description: This Java class 'MonthlyCompoundingPeriod' models a period for interest calculation with methods to compute interest based on daily or average daily balances, within a specified date interval, for savings account interest accrual.

classes.name: MonthlyCompoundingPeriod
classes.description: Final class implementing interest calculation logic for a monthly compounding period, including methods for interest calculation based on daily and average daily balances.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate a MonthlyCompoundingPeriod with a specific date interval and end-of-day balances.

methods.name: calculateInterest
methods.description: Calculates interest based on the specified interest calculation type and period type, returning the interest earned as BigDecimal.

methods.name: calculateUsingAverageDailyBalanceMethod
methods.description: Calculates interest based on the average daily balance over the period.

methods.name: calculateUsingDailyBalanceMethod
methods.description: Calculates interest based on daily or monthly balance, depending on the period type.

methods.name: endOfDayBalancesWithinPeriodInterval
methods.description: Filters and caps end-of-day balances to the specified period interval.

methods.name: getPeriodInterval
methods.description: Returns the date interval representing the period.
